起来.why: HSK/standard citation form is qǐlái; the toneless 'qi lai' is only the post-verb complement variant

刚刚.why: both syllables are first tone (gānggāng); no neutral tone

受不了.why: the 不 in a potential complement is neutral: shòu·buliǎo (cf. 来不及 lái bu jí in the same list)

大夫.why: dàifu for 'doctor'; dàfū is the archaic official title (surname/variant-style reading)

做生意.why: 生意 'business' is shēng·yi with neutral 意; shēngyì is the literary 'vitality' sense
